title: Bypassing the Packing Process

children:
Bypassing the packing process allows you to ship containers without 
 identifying the contents in them. You will bypass packing by creating 
 the container "on the fly" on the Close Container Window (accessed from the remote desktop system menu), and 
 immediately closing it. You only need to identify its shipment ID, weight, 
 and carrier. You will want to create and close containers in this fashion 
 if your warehouse flow does not include a traditional packing station. Remember that when you close a container in the system, you cannot pack 
 additional items in it. The system will automatically manifest the container 
 if the Auto Manifest at Close Checkbox is selected on your packing preferences 
 record (and Progistics CS is installed).

Shipment status determines what activities you 
 can perform against a container. You cannot create a container if the 
 shipment's status is not at least "In Packing", but not higher 
 than "Ship Confirmed." Also, you cannot close a container if 
 the shipment's leading status is not at least greater than or equal to 
 "In Packing."

You can only use the process described in this 
 topic if the "Allow Container Creation During Close Checkbox" 
 on the Packing Preferences Window is selected.

Detail lines on a shipment do not need to exist 
 to close a container in the Close Container Window. This is helpful when 
 you want to send out such miscellaneous shipments as customer gifts or 
 internal business shipments. However, you cannot manifest international 
 shipments without including detail lines.

If the shipment was manually added from the Shipment 
 Insight screen (

via a wave), you 
 will need to set the "Default Status When Added In Shipment Insight" 
 setting on the Outbound Status Action Window to "In Packing." 
 Otherwise, there is no way to get the shipment into the required "In 
 Packing" status without actually entering packing.

Access the Close 
 Container Window (accessed from the remote desktop system menu).

Identify the existing Shipment 
 ID and a new Container ID. Based on your packing preferences, the 
 system may automatically assign a Container ID. Note that the system will validate this new container ID to ensure that it is unique among existing shipping containers and multiple order pallets.

Identify the weight of the container 
 by either manually entering the weight or using the scale interface (via 
 the Action Menu) in the Weight Field. If appropriate, you can change 
 the weight of the container. In this case, the system will remanifest 
 the container.

If Yes, provide the 
 appropriate values in the Container Count Fields. If this is the first 
 container in the group, both of the fields will be blank. If it is a subsequent 
 container, the system will default the container values, but you can change 
 them.

Press the Close button. 
 The system will create the container and close it automatically.

: The system 
 may display the Print Documents screen, based on your packing preferences. 
 If this window is not displayed, you can access it by selecting the Print 
 Documents screen. All documents associated with the packing/unpacking 
 process are displayed on the Print Documents screen. Some of these documents 
 may be pre-selected to print. You can select any additional documents 
 that you want to print, and deselect any documents that you do not want 
 to print.

: The 
 system may also display a message box asking if you want to send this 
 shipment to an international destination (this can be configured from 
 the Rating ID Window). If you choose Yes, the system will navigate back 
 to the Close Container screen. When you process further containers, processing 
 will be normal except the manifesting process will not occur. Instead, 
 when you press the End Shipment Button, the system will open the Shipment 
 Level Manifesting screen. If you choose No, the system will return to 
 the Close Container screenwith no further processing.

Warning: If you attempt 
 to close a container for an international shipment whose rating occurs 
 at the shipment level AND trailing status is less than 401 (In Packing), 
 the system will display a warning indicating that unpacked quantity exists 
 for the shipment. If the shipment's trailing status is greater than or 
 equal to 401, then no such warning will appear.

After closing 
 the container, the system will leave this screen open. If appropriate, 
 close any other containers that are ready. When you are finished, select 
 the Cancel Button to exit the screen.
